rationale: TSM is a crowded-long laggard (LSR 2.48, structure_bias -0.30, RS -24.6%) in a macro regime hostile to semi longs, and the tape just printed a sharp rejection at 410.67 that dumped to 404.40 and flipped the 15m/5m short while 30m/1h/4h still read long — a genuinely split book (composite aligned=false). A fresh long fights the immediate rejection; a fresh short at mid-range (405) chases a move that already ran with only ~0.8% ATR of room, so a routine bounce to 408 stops it out. No R:R >= 1.5 exists here, so size stays 0 until price picks a side.

reconsider.note: Losing 404 confirms the 410 rejection and breaks near-term structure, arming a short toward 401/397 in the hostile-semis, crowded-long context.
